title: 折线图的主要特征
goal: 识别折线图的总体变化并选择代表数据。

points.label: 识别折线图的总体变化
选择支持总体特征的关键数据

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 折线图主要特征与数据筛选

body.p: 折线图的横轴表示时间，纵轴表示数值。图例说明每条线代表什么，纵轴标题给出指标和单位。动笔前先确认年份范围和单位。

body.box:
Visitors (thousands)
30 | S           N
   |  \         /
20 |       X
   |  /         \
10 | N           S
   +----------------
     2010  2012  2014  Year
N = North; S = South; X = both
North: 10, 20, 30; South: 30, 20, 10

body.p: North 从 10 千人升到 30 千人，South 从 30 千人降到 10 千人，两线在 2012 年相等。概述写总体变化，细节再用起点、交点和终点支持。

steps.d: 确认时间范围、指标和单位。上例的单位是千人，N 对应 North。
对照各线的起点和终点。North 总体上升，South 总体下降。
找出最高点、最低点，以及两线相等或交叉的位置。2012 年两条线都是 20 千人，可以支持相等的描述。
把变化相近或相反的线放在一起写。用起点、终点和交点支持概述，不逐点罗列。

cards.title: 主要特征
rows: 同一条线的第一个和最后一个数值。
比较首末数值，概括全段的方向。
North increased overall, while South declined.
South reached a low of 10,000 in 2014.
两线相等之后高低对调，就是交叉。
The two figures were equal in 2012 before North overtook South.

body.box:
The line chart shows the number of visitors to two local gardens over a six-year period. Figures are measured in thousands of people. Summarise the main features and compare the two gardens where relevant, selecting the values that best support the overall patterns.

Visitors (thousands)
40 | E                 O
   |  \               /
30 |       E     O
   |         \ /
20 |       O     E
   |  /               \
10 | O                 E
   +----------------------
     2010  2012  2014  2016  Year
O = Oak; E = Elm
Oak: 10, 20, 30, 40; Elm: 40, 30, 20, 10

body.p: Oak 从 10 升到 40，Elm 从 40 降到 10。2012 年 Oak 低于 Elm，2014 年高于 Elm，两线在这两年之间交叉。首末数值足以支持两条线相反的总体趋势。

body.box: Overall, visits to Oak increased, whereas visits to Elm fell. Oak rose from 10,000 to 40,000, while Elm declined from 40,000 to 10,000.

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 纵轴单位为千人，终点是 40,000 人。
用首末数值概括总体上升即可。

items.stem: A series moves from 12 to 18 to 24. Which summary fits?
items.why: 首末值从 12 升至 24，第一项概括总体上升。

items.stem: A series is 8, 15 and 11. Which value is its peak?
items.why: 15 是三个数值中最大值，即第二项。

items.stem: Series A is 5 then 9; series B is 9 then 5. What happened between the two points?
items.why: 第一条线从低于第二条变为高于第二条，两线之间交叉，即第三项。

items.stem: A line starts at 20, peaks at 40 and ends at 30. Which values support both its peak and final level?
items.why: 峰值是 40，终点是 30，即第四项。

items.stem: Which overview describes the two series?
options: Rail rose overall while bus fell.
Rail fell overall while bus rose.
Both means rose by the same amount.
Both means fell by the same amount.
items.why: Rail 从 10 增至 40，Bus 从 30 降至 15，即第一项。

items.stem: Which pair supports the change in rail journeys?
items.why: Rail 首末值分别为 10 千和 40 千，即第二项。

groups.text:
Bicycles hired (hundreds)
8 | P                 C
  |  \               /
6 |       P     C
  |         \ /
4 |       C     P
  |  /               \
2 | C                 P
  +----------------------
    2011  2013  2015  2017  Year
C = Canal; P = Park
Canal: 2, 4, 6, 8; Park: 8, 6, 4, 2

items.stem: Which overview fits the two lines?
options: Canal rose while Park fell overall.
Canal fell while Park rose overall.
Both locations rose across the period.
Both locations fell across the period.
items.why: Canal 从 2 升至 8，Park 从 8 降至 2，第一项符合。

items.stem: Which values support the overall change at Canal?
items.why: 单位是百辆，Canal 首末分别为 200 和 800，即第二项。

items.stem: When did the order of the two lines reverse?
items.why: 2013 年 Canal 为 4 百，低于 Park 的 6 百；2015 年 Canal 为 6 百，高于 Park 的 4 百。交叉发生在这两年之间，即第三项。

items.stem: Which pair gives the maximum and minimum for Park?
items.why: Park 的最大值是 2011 年的 8 百辆，最小值是 2017 年的 2 百辆，即第四项。
East 从 5 升至 20，increased overall 与数据一致。

items.stem: State the initial and final values for West.
items.why: West 从 20 千降至 5 千，from 表示起点，to 表示终点。
East 总体上升，West 总体下降；while 连接两个分句。

items.stem: State the peak value of East at the end of the period.
items.why: East 的最高值是 2018 年的 20 千，peaked at 后接数值。
